austin.summary: Austin, you drafted last in the snake and somehow walked out with the whole buffet. All four of your players are still in the game, all four put up 1 pts in Ep 1, and that adds up to 4 counted points and a share of rank 1 of 5. A 3.75 draft GPA this early is no accident — a farmer, a photographer, a counselor, and an entrepreneur, all pulling the same rope. With 110 points still on the table, you're right where you want to be.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Nobody's carrying anybody — Linnea, Jenna, Carter, and Eric each sit at 1 pts and rank 1 of 21, which is as balanced a start as this game allows.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Linnea's the only B on an otherwise straight-A board, so your fifth-overall pick has the most to prove.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Eric at pick #16 is your steal of the draft and already rank 1 of 21 — watch whether that charisma turns into a tribe he can steer.

kylie.summary: Kylie, you took the very first hit of this season — Aaliyah went home in Episode 1, and the First Blood badge is yours. But look closer: you sit at rank 5 of 5 with 3 counted points, and the leader has 4. That's nothing. Three of your four are still out there, all three graded A, and 85 points are still on the table. Nobody's buried in this game.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Cristian, Alexis, and Kilby are each sitting at 1 pts and each ranked 1 of 21 — a three-way engine room, with Kilby at pick #18 the steal of your entire draft.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Aaliyah at pick #3 was the reach that stung — ranked 21 of 21, 0 pts, a grade of F, and the first torch snuffed in Episode 1.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Tribes are still TBA for your remaining three, so watch where Cristian, Alexis, and Kilby land and whether your Ep 1 best week of +3 becomes the floor instead of the ceiling.

tami.summary: Tami, you drafted first and you're sitting pretty — rank 1 (tied) of 5 with 4 counted points, and all 5 of 5 still in the game. Add the Idol Whisperer badge with 2 found, a 3.6 Draft GPA, and 110 points still on the table. That's a team.

bullets.label: Watch for

taylor.summary: Taylor, you drafted second and you're sitting pretty — rank 1 (tied) of 5 with 4 counted points, and all 4 of 4 of your players still in the game. Every single name on your roster chipped in, which is how you post a best week of Ep 1 (+4). Draft GPA of 3.5 this early is nothing to sneeze at, and with 110 points still on the table, the story is just beginning. Enjoy it.

You're tied for rank 1 of 5 with 4 counted points, your Ep 1 was a clean +4, and your draft GPA sits at 3.75. With 110 points still on the table and the leader at 4, you are right in the thick of it. Nicely done.
